{"reason": "v1's 20/28 false arbitrations mostly show sub-threshold confidence: 6 of 8 failure rows have confidence <0.7 while needed=#f. Adding (high-confidence? edi-change) gates on signal quality, cutting false arbitrations without touching the pct/exposure thresholds that currently deliver recall=1.0.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
